build.scope: Build identity only; numerical, model and installed-runtime qualification are separate gates.

tolerances.note: Parallel scaling includes an unscaled 1e15-ohm simulator shunt and a retained IHP internal-conductance cancellation residual. No conductance below 1e-14 S is qualified; application/reference and fault criteria remain unchanged.

diagnostics: Original ngspice 47 concatenates scientific/parameter capacitor multipliers with e9 and fails parsing. The first patch retained nested braces and also failed. Both failures, original source, exact successful patch, licenses and source archive are retained.

The original SKY130 VM>1 varactor models do not match three parallel VM=1 units. A separate opt-in wrapper package defines positive VM as parallel unit devices, including substrate parasitics. Original assets and default package remain unchanged. The first wrapper had a parameter-name collision; its failure is retained.

Earlier strict parallel checks failed at numerical conductances of approximately 1e-15 S. The explicit 1e-14-A floor is supported by the retained shunt and precision experiments; the independently emitted application/reference comparison still uses 1e-15 A.
The first Windows package-exchange test fixture overlapped all symbols and was rejected for conflicting labels. A spaced fixture passes without changing exchange code.
remaining: Full bias, geometry, temperature, reliability and statistical envelopes; silicon-model accuracy and RF-band behavior.
Physical layouts and extracted connectivity for remaining capacitor families, and default promotion of the explicit SKY130 parallel-varactor contract.
Complete release-image and installed Windows/Linux acceptance of this corrected simulator build.
Other chunk-7 device families, unavailable required devices and complete upstream device/process-option inventory.
